## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits, one change per commit
- [ ] `tests/run_tests.sh` passes locally
- [ ] `python tools/i18n/extract_messages.py --check` passes, with new text translated in `godot/i18n/id.po`
- [ ] New third-party assets or data are recorded in `assets/LICENSES.md` and `godot/data/credits.json`
- [ ] README and `docs/PRD.md` describe any new feature or control
- [ ] Code has no comments unless they are necessary
